title: How we’ll decide together
description: Four steps from a first call to a proposal, with one decision point after the first call.
heading: How we’ll decide together

steps.name: First call
steps.question: Is there a reason to talk?
steps.description: We look at where your go-live stands and what’s at stake.
steps.leave: A clear yes or no on a longer conversation.

steps.name: Discovery
steps.question: What are the needs, and whose?
steps.description: We hear from the people closest to the go-live, including your sponsor and program lead.
steps.leave: A shared picture of the risks.

steps.name: Scoping
steps.question: What could we do together?
steps.description: We agree on the results, approach and investment.
steps.leave: Agreement on scope and price, and a time to review the proposal.

steps.name: Proposal
steps.question: What else do you need before we start?
steps.description: I present the proposal to you and your approver. We confirm approvals and procurement.
steps.leave: The proposal, a decision date and a kickoff plan.

decisionText: Do we both see a fit? If yes, we schedule the longer conversation. Either of us can stop at any point.
focusHint: Select a step to focus on it.
